news.title: Remembering Robert H. Buckman: A legacy of engineering excellence and generosity
news.summary_en: Robert H. Buckman's life and legacy stand as a model of leadership, global citizenship and unwavering dedication to Purdue University.

news.title: Purdue researchers will test forces that could determine how we find our way, build and survive in space
news.summary_en: The Purdue 1 mission is a first: a university-led, research-focused suborbital flight with an all-Boilermaker crew. In a few minutes of weightlessness, experiments that span quantum physics, manufacturing and fluid dynamics will test whether the systems that humanity will need in space can be made efficient, reliable and operationally resilient.

news.title: Registration open for July 27 LyoHUB/FDA workshop addressing critical needs in pharmaceutical inspection and quality assurance
news.summary_en: In collaboration with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and 40+ industry partners, LyoHUB is hosting a workshop in the Washington, D.C., area to discuss safety measures for parenteral drug products that are lyophilized.
